name: NANTES
title: Classical character. A place to live.
tagline: Oak burl. Black lacquer. Classical interiors.
description: Twenty-two distinct MARINER references connect a furnished window salon, a marble dining room and an intimate charcoal bedroom. Amber oak burl, fine sycamore inlay, black lacquer framing, delicate gilt lattice and pale damask follow the supplied catalogue. Panel mouldings, banded curtains, urn lamps, chandeliers and soft textiles restore the architectural context. The connected plan and unshown construction remain authored interpretations, not a measured copy of a source building.
finish: NAN. / OF (544/55); chairs and stool NAN. (544)
